question: The three sides of a triangle are 9, 24 and S units. Which of the following is correct?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any triangle with sides **a**, **b**, and **c**, the third side **c** must lie in the range:

|a − b| [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Side 1 (a) = 9 units

Side 2 (b) = 24 units

Side 3 (c) = S units

**Formula Used:**

**Triangle Inequality Theorem:** The sum of the lengths of any two sides of a triangle must be strictly greater than the length of the third side.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec809b275248f838cddceb3703960f65cf443149b507de72b7bcdfc3c88065d9.png] 

According to the theorem, for sides 9, 24, and S:

⇒ Case 1: 9 + 24 > S

⇒ 33 > S or S 24

⇒ S > 24 − 9

⇒ S > 15

⇒ Case 3: 24 + S > 9 (Always true for any positive S)

Combining the conditions from Case 1 and Case 2:

⇒ 15 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Triangle Inequality Theorem

This theorem states that the sum of any two sides of a triangle is greater than the third side, which prevents the triangle from collapsing into a straight line.

Range of the Third Side

If two sides are x and y, the third side z must satisfy: (Difference of x,y) < z < (Sum of x,y).

Degenerate Triangle

A triangle where the sum of two sides equals the third side (a + b = c) is called a degenerate triangle, where the three vertices are collinear.</p
